01 / MY ROAD

Every kilometre
earns its place.

Your ride is more than a line on a map. It is the early start, the climb you nearly gave up on, the checkpoint you reached, the weather you crossed and the finish you earned. My Road — My Glory turns those real details into a personal VYNDI Ride Story built from your GPX, photographs, bib, brevet and medal.

GLOBAL EVENT FINDER

Find the event.
Make the memory yours.

Search named events around the world, select the edition you rode, and send the event identity into the VYNDI Ride Memento creator. VYNDI uses event metadata to create an original treatment; official logos or artwork are only included when you upload material you have permission to use.

Official mark candidate found

View source / licence ↗
Event names and factual details may be referenced. A discovered or uploaded mark enters the memento only after an explicit rights confirmation; otherwise VYNDI uses its own event signature.
What if VYNDI finds the event but not my exact edition?

Select the event, then confirm your edition date, location and distance. The production brief records those confirmed details separately from the discovery source.

What if I do not have the event GPX?

You can still create the event treatment and request route verification. VYNDI should not claim an organiser route as exact until it has been verified for the relevant edition.

Can VYNDI use the official event logo or poster?

Only when the customer or VYNDI Ride Stories has permission to use that material. Otherwise VYNDI creates an original event signature from factual event metadata.

Can’t find it? Create an event request
